human_tasks.value: Cross-over: operator 1 does A manually and B with product; operator 2 does the reverse. Measure collection, analysis, packaging, waiting and correction separately.
human_tasks.H2: On saved outputs compare review-all and review-risk-only; no-review is measured from raw output and receives no hidden correction.
human_tasks.H3: Use different balanced event clusters for flat and event views; measure time and recovery of unique facts and positions.
human_tasks.H4: Compare manual cleaning of one common release with checking PR/GR/HEAD releases; critical core must remain everywhere required.
human_tasks.H5: On different balanced flows ask recipient to name main events, critical items and evidence using full queue versus top layer with drill-down.

reporting: Never merge machine quality, human time and product hypotheses into one number. Synthetic outcomes are preliminary proxy evidence.
